data.body:
AC5 remeasured on the current pin, 2026-11-12 01:41-02:22 PST (2402 s).
- Tree: origin/main 0fccb0f20aa plus the salvaged impl-2fb4 diff (AC1-AC4), rebased by hand: the test_code_review_evals.py conflict kept both sides (e508 antipattern-pairing tests and the 2fb4 advisory tests); the spec and scorer hunks applied cleanly. 31/31 unit tests in test_code_review_evals.py pass.
- Run: run_eval("code-review-tests", max_cases=None) inside a gate_source.gate_read_root session, AWS_PROFILE=frontier. Every reviewer call in the usage log went to bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5 (configured frontier class), outcome ok.
- Result: passed=false, epoch_pass [false, false, false], coverage 1.0, gate at_least(2) of 3 epochs.
- 231 scored rows: code_review_recall 57/57 pass, code_review_emits_valid_findings 117/117 pass, code_review_no_fire 49/57 pass. 8 false fires = 14.0% per no-fire case-run (19 no-fire cases x 3 epochs), across 7 distinct cases: FP-loc-anti-fragmentation-floor (e0, e2), FP-deliberate-tightening (e0), FP-failopen-absence-with-liveness-anchor (e1), FP-loc-numeric-budget-not-a-file-size (e1), FP-gatererun-fixture-tree (e1), FP-rule5-structural-grep (e2), FP-sleep-as-secondary (e2).
- So the 5.5 pin does not reach AC5 either; its rate is in the same range as the opus-4-8 measurement (~11.5%). Proceeding with option (1): calibrate the false-positive guards. Capturing the false findings for those 7 cases (3 reps each) now to see which guard each one should have stopped.
